title: Building the Tabernacle

questions.question: Why did Moses tell the people to stop bringing offerings?
options: The people had already brought more than enough
questions.correctAnswer: The people had already brought more than enough
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:6-7 (ESV): "The people were restrained from bringing, for the material they had was sufficient to do all the work, and more."

questions.question: Who did the work of building the tabernacle?
options: Bezalel, Oholiab, and every craftsman in whom God put skill
questions.correctAnswer: Bezalel, Oholiab, and every craftsman in whom God put skill
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:1 (ESV): "Bezalel and Oholiab and every craftsman in whom the Lord has put skill."

questions.question: How many inner curtains of fine linen were made?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:8 (ESV): "All the craftsmen among the workmen made the tabernacle with ten curtains."

questions.question: What figures were woven into the curtains?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:8 (ESV): "Of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet yarns, with cherubim skillfully worked."

questions.question: What joined the curtain sets together?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:13 (ESV): "He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one to the other with the clasps."

questions.question: How many goat-hair curtains were made for the outer tent?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:14 (ESV): "He also made curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle. He made eleven curtains."

questions.question: What were the bases for the tabernacle frames made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:24 (ESV): "He made forty bases of silver under the twenty frames."

questions.question: What material were the frames overlaid with?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:34 (ESV): "He overlaid the frames with gold."

questions.question: How many frames were on the south side?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:23 (ESV): "He made twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle."

questions.question: What separated the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place?
options: A veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn
questions.correctAnswer: A veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:35 (ESV): "He made the veil of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen; with cherubim skillfully worked."

questions.question: How many bars held each side of the tabernacle together?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:31-32 (ESV): "He made bars of acacia wood, five for the frames of one side... five bars for the frames of the other side."

questions.question: What was special about the middle bar?
options: It ran through from end to end halfway up the frames
questions.correctAnswer: It ran through from end to end halfway up the frames
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:33 (ESV): "He made the middle bar to run from end to end halfway up the frames."

questions.question: How many pillars supported the veil?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:36 (ESV): "He made for it four pillars of acacia and overlaid them with gold."

questions.question: What were the bases of the veil's pillars made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:36 (ESV): "He cast for them four bases of silver."

questions.question: What was the outermost covering of the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: Exodus 36:19 (ESV): "He made for the tent a covering of tanned rams' skins and a covering of goatskins on top."

key_verse_text: For the material they had was sufficient to do all the work, and more.
